title: Republic Act No. 11811

Highteenth Congress

[ REPUBLIC ACT No. 11811]

AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CENTRAL MULTI-SPECIES
MARINE HATCHERY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF
SAN JOSE, PROVINCE OF OCCIDENTAL MINDORO,
AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
Philippines in Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. There shall be established, under the
supervision of the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources of
the Department of Agriculture (BFAR-DA), acentral multi-species
marine hatchery in the Municipality of San Jose, Province of
Occidental Mindoro.

SEC. 2. Prior to the establishment of the central
multi-species marine hatchery, the BFAR-DA shall conduct a
full-scale feasibility study in support of its construction to comply
with the requirements of the Department of Budget
and Management.
 
Within two (2) years after the construction of the central
multi-species marine hatchery, the BFAR-DA, through a
memorandum of agreement, shall transfer its management
to the local government of the Municipality of San Jose. It
shall implement a training and phasing-in program for local
government personnel on the management and operation of the
central hatchery.

Sec. 3. The BFAR-DA shall conduct continuing research
and experimentation on the breeding and production of
marine species, especially as they apply to local conditions, to
discover new methods and technologies that will enhance the
fishing industry.

Sec. 4. The Secretary of Agriculture shall include in the
Department’s programs the conduct of the feasibility study
and the consequent establishment of the central multi-species
marine hatchery in the Municipality of San Jose, Province of
Occidental Mindoro, the funding of which shall be included in the
General Appropriations Act. The local government unit concerned
shall set aside funds from any available local revenue in an amount
deemed appropriate for the operationalization of the hatchery.

SEc. 5. Within sixty (60) days from the effectivity of this
Act, the Secretary of Agriculture shall issue the rules and
regulations on the supervision, operation, monitoring, and the
eventual transfer of the central multi-species marine hatchery to
the local government of the Municipality of San Jose.

SEC. 6. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after
its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of
general circulation.
